intro: {{nameA}} and {{nameB}} both sit in {{cityA}}, and this page compares their recorded {{course}} fees, placements, admission routes and campus setting, using our database and official pages we opened in {{year}}.
HBTU Kanpur vs PSIT Kanpur is not a single winner. HBTU Kanpur has a recorded NIRF 2021 #251, and PSIT Kanpur has no NIRF rank on this page.

sections.heading: HBTU Kanpur vs PSIT Kanpur for B.Tech: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose HBTU Kanpur if you want a recorded NIRF 2021 #251, and a recorded fee of ₹70,000, in a public B.Tech setting at Kanpur.
Choose PSIT Kanpur if you want a recorded fee of ₹54,750, and an admission route through UPSEE, in a private B.Tech setting at Kanpur.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show, and what the official pages say
paragraphs: On this page we quote a programme total when we hold a Total Fees record, and we skip short, executive or certificate rows when the picker can tell them apart. Always match the fee to the exact programme you will join.

Our records show ₹70,000 as a tuition figure for B.Tech Computer Science & Engineering at HBTU Kanpur. Treat this as a recorded tuition figure, not a confirmed two-year total, unless the official notice says otherwise.

Our records show ₹54,750 as a tuition figure for B.Tech Electronics & Communication Engineering at PSIT Kanpur. Treat this as a recorded tuition figure, not a confirmed two-year total, unless the official notice says otherwise.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: We do not hold a 2020-or-later flagship placement year for HBTU Kanpur here, so do not treat older or unofficial packages as current.
We do not hold a 2020-or-later flagship placement year for PSIT Kanpur here, so do not treat older or unofficial packages as current.
If you are comparing offers, use the latest official placement report from each institute and match the programme name, not an executive or certificate batch.

sections.heading: Admission and eligibility
paragraphs: HBTU Kanpur is listed on our records with JEE Main as an admission route for this B.Tech comparison. Confirm the current brochure for cut-offs, interviews and any extra institute test.
PSIT Kanpur is listed on our records with UPSEE as an admission route for this B.Tech comparison. Confirm the current brochure for cut-offs, interviews and any extra institute test.
Eligibility wording can change by cycle. Use the current official admission brochure rather than last year's cut-off stories.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Both campuses are in {{cityA}}, Uttar Pradesh. If you want to stay in this city, the choice is less about relocation and more about the classroom, fees and the admission route.
HBTU Kanpur is listed as a public institute and PSIT Kanpur as a private institute on our records. That difference can affect fees, seat reservations and campus culture.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: If you prefer a public B.Tech campus and the reservation or fee pattern that often comes with it, HBTU Kanpur is the better fit on our records.
Use official fee notices rather than our raw minimums, then decide whether PSIT Kanpur's recorded ₹54,750 or HBTU Kanpur's ₹70,000 fits your budget for this B.Tech.
If fees are the only filter, do not use the lowest number in our raw rows. Check each official fee notice for the exact programme and batch you will join.

faqs.question: Which is better in 2026, HBTU Kanpur or PSIT Kanpur?
faqs.answer: It depends on the programme you want.

faqs.question: What are the recorded fees for HBTU Kanpur vs PSIT Kanpur?
faqs.answer: our records list ₹70,000 for HBTU Kanpur on B.Tech Computer Science & Engineering; our records list ₹54,750 for PSIT Kanpur on B.Tech Electronics & Communication Engineering. Confirm both official notices before you decide.

faqs.question: How do placements compare for HBTU Kanpur and PSIT Kanpur?
faqs.answer: We do not hold a 2020-or-later flagship placement year for HBTU Kanpur here, so do not treat older or unofficial packages as current.

faqs.question: Which entrance exams do HBTU Kanpur and PSIT Kanpur accept?
faqs.answer: Our records list JEE Main for HBTU Kanpur, and UPSEE for PSIT Kanpur. Always confirm the current admission brochure, because tests and cut-offs change by year.

faqs.question: Are HBTU Kanpur and PSIT Kanpur in the same city?
faqs.answer: Yes. Both are in Kanpur, Uttar Pradesh. The move is about the programme, fees and tests, not a change of city.

faqs.question: Should I treat this comparison as a final admission decision?
faqs.answer: No. Fees, eligibility and placements change by year and by programme. Verify the current official fee notice, admission brochure and placement report of each institute before you apply.
